_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-login-keycloak container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-login-keycloak container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-login-keycloak container in MiB

deployment.description: mod-login-keycloak keeps no session state: credentials and login attempt counters live in Keycloak, password actions in PostgreSQL, and the Keycloak admin token and client configuration caches are rebuilt on demand. Replicas can run side by side behind a load balancer; two are recommended because every user login goes through the module.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name holding the mod-login-keycloak schemas

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of connections in the database connection pool. The pool library default (10) applies when unset. DB_MAXPOOLSIZE, used by other FOLIO modules, is not read by this module

EnvVars.name: DB_MINSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Minimum number of idle connections the pool tries to maintain

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds applied to every database connection; no timeout is set when unset

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Time in milliseconds after which an idle database connection is closed

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime in milliseconds of a database connection (30 minutes by default); 0 means unlimited

EnvVars.name: DB_CHARSET
EnvVars.description: Character encoding of database connections

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host. Used to publish logout events

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to communicate with Kafka brokers (PLAINTEXT or SSL)

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name, used as the Kafka topic prefix; must be unique across all environments sharing the same Kafka cluster and match the value used by the other modules. Falls back to 'folio' when unset

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Tenant collection name for the logout topic; must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30}. ALL is the value used by the other FOLIO modules. When unset, empty or false, per-tenant topics are used; true means ALL. Any other value fails the module startup

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_LOGOUT_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the logout topic created at startup

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_LOGOUT_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor of the logout topic; the broker default applies when unset

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on. The module defaults to 8081, which the co-located sidecar uses, so it is moved to 8082 and the sidecar MODULE_URL must point at it

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mod-login-keycloak process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure store backend holding the per-tenant Keycloak client secrets. Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP. There is no default

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_ENV
EnvVars.description: First segment of the secure store key, for example prod or test. Defaults to the value of ENV, with fallback to 'folio'

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM; when unset the AWS default region provider chain is used

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the IAM role of the running task for SSM authorization instead of explicit credentials. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of Keycloak, used for login, token and credential operations

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the Keycloak master realm admin user, used to obtain the admin token (sourced from secret store). There is no default

EnvVars.name: KC_LOGIN_CLIENT_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Suffix appended to the tenant name to derive the Keycloak login client ID (e.g. diku-application). Must match the value used by mgr-tenants and the module sidecars

EnvVars.name: KC_CONFIG_TTL
EnvVars.description: Time-to-live of the cached Keycloak client configuration and client credentials (Spring Duration syntax)

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_TOKEN_CACHE_REFRESH_PRIOR_EXPIRATION_SEC
EnvVars.description: Seconds before expiry at which the cached Keycloak admin token is refreshed

EnvVars.name: X_OKAPI_TOKEN_HEADER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: When true, the login endpoints also return the access token in the x-okapi-token response header, for clients that still read it

EnvVars.name: LOGIN_COOKIE_SAMESITE
EnvVars.description: SameSite attribute of the login cookies (NONE, LAX or STRICT)
